policy: A public URL is not a training licence. Candidate material remains outside training until its exact item licence, provenance, content quality and required human reviews all pass.
training_approval_policy: This registry records research and staging evidence only. No field in this registry can grant training approval; sources.json remains the sole approved-manifest boundary.

candidates.title: Storybooks Nigeria English catalogue — CC BY subset
candidates.observed_license: 20 CC BY 3.0 and 9 CC BY 4.0 items staged; 11 CC BY-NC 3.0 items excluded
candidates.next_action: Nigerian primary teacher reviews all 29 staged stories for reading level, cultural fit, factual quality and child safety before any manifest approval.
candidates.notes: This is an African reading collection delivered through Storybooks Nigeria. It does not by itself satisfy the Nigerian-authored story or Nigerian English composition gates.

candidates.title: Storybooks Nigeria — Nigerian Pidgin catalogue
candidates.observed_license: 6 CC BY 3.0 and 1 CC BY 4.0 item; no NC item in the seven-story catalogue
candidates.next_action: A qualified Nigerian Pidgin speaker, Nigerian primary teacher and safeguarding lead review all seven staged texts.
candidates.notes: Seven commercial-compatible text editions are pinned and staged; none is training-approved.

candidates.title: Storybooks Nigeria — Hausa CC BY subset
candidates.observed_license: 4 CC BY items; 2 CC BY-NC items excluded
candidates.next_action: A qualified Hausa speaker, Nigerian primary teacher and safeguarding lead review all four staged texts.
candidates.notes: Four CC BY texts are staged; two CC BY-NC items and the separate page-scrambled Hausa booklet remain excluded.

candidates.title: Storybooks Nigeria — Yoruba candidate subset
candidates.observed_license: 5 CC BY 3.0 and 1 CC BY 4.0 item; 2 CC BY-NC 3.0 items excluded
candidates.next_action: A qualified Yoruba speaker, Nigerian primary teacher and safeguarding lead review all six staged texts.
candidates.notes: Six CC BY texts are pinned and staged; two CC BY-NC items remain excluded.

candidates.title: StoryWeaver books in Hausa, Yoruba and Igbo
candidates.observed_license: Story books are generally CC BY 4.0; media can use different terms
candidates.next_action: Select exact text editions, capture every attribution and licence, exclude audio/video, and obtain a qualified speaker review for each language.

candidates.title: Global Digital Library primary mathematics
candidates.observed_license: Platform hosts Creative Commons and other open licences; exact resource terms must be retained
candidates.next_action: Identify downloadable text resources with commercial-compatible licences, then localise examples and obtain Nigerian teacher review without copying incompatible material.
candidates.notes: Some examples use non-Nigerian currency or contexts and therefore need review; platform-level licensing is not enough.

candidates.title: Official Nigerian primary curriculum pages and PDFs
candidates.provider: Nigerian Educational Research and Development Council
candidates.observed_license: Publicly accessible; no verified open training/reuse licence
candidates.next_action: Use only as a topic checklist unless written reuse permission or an affirmative open licence is obtained.
candidates.notes: Public accessibility does not grant model-training rights.

candidates.title: Nigeria Learning Passport curriculum resources
candidates.provider: Federal Ministry of Education / UNICEF and partners
candidates.observed_license: Free learner access; no verified open model-training/reuse licence
candidates.next_action: Seek written permission or item-level open-licence evidence before any extraction.
candidates.notes: Free access is not equivalent to an open licence.

candidates.title: Siyavula Nigeria NERDC mathematics JSS 1–3
candidates.observed_license: Unbranded versions CC BY 3.0; branded versions CC BY-ND
candidates.next_action: Do not add to the primary corpus. Reconsider only if the project scope expands, using unbranded CC BY files only.
candidates.notes: Useful Nigerian material, but it does not satisfy the primary mathematics requirement.

candidates.title: Treasure EDU original Nigerian primary curriculum pack
candidates.next_action: Create topic-by-topic original lessons and exercises, record authorship, obtain owner licence confirmation, and require Nigerian teacher plus safeguarding review before approval.
candidates.notes: This is likely the safest route to substantial Nigerian alignment, but no synthetic or assistant-authored text should be marked human-reviewed.
